evidence.source_text: Electrocatalytic performance in a three-electrode confi guration The electrocatalytic activities toward OER of $\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ 2 were measured using a standard three-electrode configuration in $0.1\:\mathrm{M}\:\mathrm{H C l O}_{4}$ electrolyte. As the $\mathrm{IrO}_{2}$ content increases,the electrocatalytic activity for OER increased rapidly (Fig. 4a), and reaches its optimization when the Ir content is 16 wt%. However, a further increase in the Ir content of the $\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ results in a slight deterioration of the electrocatalytic activity. The required overpotential to generate a current density of $10\mathrm{m A}\mathrm{c m}^{-2}$ (normalized over the electrode geometric area) for 16 wt%$\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ is 288 mV, lower than that of unsupported $\mathrm{I r O}_{2}\left(307\mathrm{m V}\right)$ The Tafel slope of 16 wt%$\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ 2is 42.6 mV dec-1 (Supplementary Fig. 8), close to that of unsupported $\mathbf{I r O}_{2}$ (45.1mV dec-1),indicating that the the $\mathsf{T a B}_{2}$ _support has no change to OER pathway of $\mathrm{I r O}_{2}$

Electrochemical double layer capacitance (DLC) measurements were carried out to obtain the electrochemically active surface area $\left(\mathrm{E C S A}\right)\mathrm{o f}\mathrm{I r O}_{2}@\mathrm{T a B}_{2}$ by estimating the accumulated charge amount at the electrode surface. Generally, the ECSA values become larger with increasing Ir content in $\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ 2 (Fig. 4b, left and Supplementary Table 6). In order to compare the intrinsic activities of different catalysts, we normalized the measured currents by the ECSAs (Fig. 4b,right). The 16 wt%$\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ presents the highest current density $(j_{ECSA})$ at 1.53V versus reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE) among these $\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ ,samples, which is 5.2 times larger than that of $\mathbf{I r O}_{2},$ We further compared the iridium mass activities of $\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ and $\mathrm{I r O}_{2}$ by normalizing the measured currents over the mass of iridium $(j_{\mathrm{i r}})$ . Although 16%$\mathrm{IrO_{2}@TaB_{2}}$ has 70 wt% less iridium relative to $\mathbf{I r O}_{2}$ ,it displays a high iridium mass activity of $345\mathrm{A g^{-1}}$ at $1.53\mathrm{V}$ versus RHE
